proposal=json.loads((p.OUT/'proposal.json').read_text())
original_table=p.roles.noise.noise_table;original_geometry=p.rec.old.geometry
for cases in ([proposal['panels']['legacy'][0]],[proposal['panels']['controlled_remaining'][0]]):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
  d=Path(tmp);raw=p.instrument(cases,'diff3','original',d)
  try:
   meta=json.loads((d/'geometry.json').read_text());contract=json.loads((d/'broad_contract.json').read_text())
   assert meta['case_ids']==contract['cases']==[cases[0]['seed']]
   assert meta['recording_case_ids']==contract['recording_ids']
   if isinstance(cases[0]['seed'],str):
    assert isinstance(contract['recording_ids'][0],int) and meta['boxes']==[[]]
   else:
    expected=original_geometry(raw);actual=p.geometry(raw)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(expected[0],actual[0]);assert expected[1]==actual[1]
   assert raw.scenarios[0].delay_ms==cases[0]['scenario']['delay_ms']
   assert not raw.state.numpy()[:,0].any() and not raw.data.time.numpy().any()
  finally:raw.close()
assert p.roles.noise.noise_table is original_table and p.rec.old.geometry is original_geometry
